name: Porphyritic-Maw

civilization.name: The Pale Assemblies
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: Silence has shape here: boulder fields, shattered scarps, knife-edge shadows, and far to the south, massive canyon systems. Nothing wears any of it smooth.
No wind, no voice, no weather: the landscape communicates in light and shadow alone, and it has plenty to say at sunrise.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
Whoever controls uranium controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
